mode.title: Ingest mode
mode.description: taichung-csv (default): download a county open-data CSV. api: query-by-business-item (national scaling).

csvFileOid.title: CSV file oid (taichung-csv mode)
csvFileOid.description: GCIS downloadable file oid. Defaults to the Taichung E營造及工程業 CSV from config/gcis-sources.json.

counties.title: County filter
counties.description: Optional: keep only rows in these 縣市 (CSV may already be one county). 台/臺 normalised.

defaultTradeCategory.title: Default trade category
defaultTradeCategory.description: Trade bucket applied to all CSV rows (the county CSV is already one industry, e.g. 營造).

itemCodes.title: 營業項目代碼 (api mode)
itemCodes.description: Construction business-item codes to pull. Defaults to config/industry-codes.json.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retry attempts on HTTP 429 / 5xx with exponential backoff.
